meta.description: Webhook -> Normalize Alert -> (delegates Evidence Collection / Risk Signals / ML Score / Claude Investigation / Parse Output / Store Recommendation / Audit / Notify to the orchestration API) -> Acknowledge. See n8n/README.md for why the investigation logic itself lives in the app, not in n8n nodes.

nodes.name: Normalize Alert
nodes.notes: Maps whatever shape the upstream rule engine sends into the canonical AlertWebhookPayload the orchestration API validates (lib/orchestration/webhookSchema.ts).

nodes.name: Compute Webhook Signature
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 over the exact JSON body being sent, keyed by the AML_WEBHOOK_SECRET credential — must match lib/orchestration/webhookAuth.ts's verifyWebhookSignature exactly (same JSON.stringify output, no re-serialization downstream).

nodes.name: Call Investigation API
nodes.notes: Delegates Fetch Transaction History / Fetch Customer-KYC Evidence / Sanctions Evidence / ML Features+Score / Merge Evidence / Claude Investigation / Parse Structured Output / Store Recommendation / Create Audit Event / Notify Analyst to lib/orchestration/investigationService.ts. The workflow stops here — HUMAN_REVIEW is a separate, analyst-driven trigger (see 02-human-review.workflow.json), never automatic.

nodes.name: Notify Ops (Pipeline Failure)
nodes.notes: Task section 13 safe failure: if the investigation pipeline itself is unreachable/erroring (not a normal ML/Claude degraded response, which the API already handles and returns 200/202 for), ops needs to know — the alert must not silently vanish.

parameters.text: =AML investigation API call failed for alert (status {{ $json.statusCode }}). Alert was NOT investigated automatically — route to manual review. Response: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}
